docRequirement: hooks.md#setup binds two things at once. (1) Firing: "Fires only when you launch Claude Code with `--init-only`, or with `--init` or `--maintenance` in [non-interactive mode](/docs/en/headless) with the `-p` flag. It doesn't fire on normal startup." (hooks.md:1061), with the matcher table at hooks.md:1063-1067 mapping matcher `init` -> `claude --init-only` / `claude -p --init` and matcher `maintenance` -> `claude -p --maintenance`. (2) Payload: "In addition to the [common input fields](#common-input-fields), Setup hooks receive a `trigger` field set to either `\"init\"` or `\"maintenance\"`" (hooks.md:1085), and the example body carries exactly `"hook_event_name": "Setup", "trigger": "init"` (hooks.md:1088-1094). The matcher field for Setup is therefore `trigger`, and its only two legal values are `init` and `maintenance`.
current:
Nessy emits `Setup`, but from the wrong place, at the wrong time, with the wrong payload.

- Sole emitter in the repo: `packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.ts:107` — `await options.emit('Setup', { hook_event_name: 'Setup', source: 'pi-runtime', lifecycle_version: 1 })`, inside the `pi.on('session_start', ...)` handler opened at :104 behind a `sessionStarted` once-guard (:94, :105-106), immediately before the `SessionStart` emission at :114. `grep -a` for `'Setup'` across `packages/` and `apps/` returns no other emitter.
- No launch-mode gate exists to hang it on: `apps/cli/src/index.ts:21-49` (`CliArgs`) and `:77-140` (`parseArgs` switch) have no `--init-only`, `--init` or `--maintenance` case. `grep -an "init-only|initOnly|--maintenance"` over `packages`, `apps` and `scripts` (excluding `dist/`) returns exactly two hits, and both are comments saying we do not have the mode: `packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-automation.ts:347` and `packages/shared/src/automations/utils.ts:227`.
- The payload shape is frozen without `trigger`: `packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:38` declares the Setup contract row as `redactedPayload: ['source', 'lifecycle_version']`, `owner: 'lifecycle-bridge'`, `terminalDelivery: 'once-per-session'`.
- The field exists on the shared input type but is typed for a different event: `packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:768` — `trigger?: 'manual' | 'auto';`, with the comment at :764-766 stating "hooks.md also names `trigger` as `Setup`'s matcher field, with the unrelated vocabulary `init | maintenance`. Nessy never sets it there".
- Matching is therefore dead by construction: `packages/shared/src/automations/utils.ts:161` `getMatchValueForSdkInput` has no `Setup` arm; Setup falls to `default: return ''` at :238, with the reason spelled out at :226-228. `packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-automation.ts:347` lists Setup in `MATCHER_INERT_AGENT_EVENTS`, and `:768-777` raises a registration warning `plugin.hooks.matcher_never_matches` for any narrowing matcher on it.
- Consequence pinned by test: `packages/shared/src/automations/conditions.test.ts:661-662` asserts `matcherMatchesSdk(claude('init'), 'Setup', { hook_event_name: 'Setup', source: 'pi-runtime' })` is `false`, and `:668` asserts `claude('*')` is `true` — an imported Setup hook is catch-all or nothing.
- Imported Claude Setup hooks reach that event unchanged: `packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters.ts:124` maps `Setup -> 'Setup'`, `packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-automation.ts:373` maps it to the agent event, and `packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:152` restricts only the handler TYPES (`command`/`mcp_tool`), never the firing rule.
- Emission crosses the subprocess boundary as `{ type: 'automation_event', event, input }` (`packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:1969`) and is dispatched host-side at `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:2324-2344`, where only `SessionStart` is special-cased (:2325-2329) and `Setup` falls through to `emitAutomationEvent`.
- No other backend emits it at all: `packages/shared/src/agent/claude-agent.ts`, `codex-agent.ts` and `nestor-cloud-agent.ts` emit `SessionStart` (`codex-agent.ts:446`, `nestor-cloud-agent.ts:261`) and never `Setup`.
divergence:
Three deltas, and none of them is a key rename.

1. Firing rule inverted. The doc says Setup does not fire on normal startup and fires only under `--init-only` / `-p --init` / `-p --maintenance`. Nessy fires it on every Pi `session_start` (`lifecycle-bridge.ts:104-107`), i.e. on ordinary startup, which is the exact case the doc excludes.
2. The documented key is absent, not misspelled. The payload carries `source: 'pi-runtime'` and `lifecycle_version: 1` and no `trigger` at all (`lifecycle-bridge.ts:107`, frozen at `automations/types.ts:38`). `source` is not a renamed `trigger`: `pi-runtime` is not one of the two legal values, and `source` is separately the documented matcher field of `SessionStart` (`utils.ts:190-191`), so re-reading `source` as Setup's trigger would collide.
3. The gate the value would come from does not exist. There is no launch mode in the product to derive `init` vs `maintenance` from (`apps/cli/src/index.ts:77-140`), so this cannot be fixed at the emitter alone — the trigger has to be introduced at the CLI and carried to the host.

Downstream of those: Setup's matcher is inert (`utils.ts:238`, `hooks-automation.ts:347`), so an imported Claude Setup hook is all-or-nothing — catch-all hooks over-fire once per session, correctly-matched (`init`/`maintenance`) hooks never fire.

change.what: Add the three launch flags. `CliArgs` (:21-49) gains `initOnly: boolean`, `init: boolean`, `maintenance: boolean`; `parseArgs` (:51-140) gains `case '--init-only'`, `case '--init'`, `case '--maintenance'` beside the existing `--safe-mode` case (:129-131); `printHelp` documents them. Resolve to one trigger: `--init-only` or `--init` -> `'init'`, `--maintenance` -> `'maintenance'` (hooks.md:1063-1067). Per hooks.md:1075, `--init` and `--maintenance` only take effect in print/non-interactive mode — the CLI's `run` already is print mode (`cmdRun` calls `spawnLocalServer(args, { printMode: true })` at :782), so reject them on other commands rather than silently ignoring.

Two behaviours. For `--init-only`: skip the `No prompt provided` guard at :767-770, connect, resolve the workspace and create the session as today (:806-824), run the setup path, then `cleanup()` and exit WITHOUT `sessions:send` — hooks.md:1073 "runs Setup hooks and `SessionStart` hooks with the `startup` matcher, then exits without starting a conversation", and hooks.md:1079 "On success, `--init-only` prints nothing to the terminal." For `-p --init` / `-p --maintenance`: pass the trigger with session creation so Setup runs before the prompt turn.

Carry an optional `setupTrigger: 'init' | 'maintenance'` from the CLI's session-create RPC through `SessionManager` onto the agent config, and expose whatever the `--init-only` path needs to run the bootstrap hooks and return. This is the CLI<->server wire boundary; the field must be optional so existing clients are unaffected.

Add `protected async emitSetup(trigger: 'init' | 'maintenance'): Promise<void>` calling `this.emitAutomationEvent('Setup', { hook_event_name: 'Setup', trigger })`. Host-owned for the same reason `InstructionsLoaded` was moved host-side (see the comment at `lifecycle-bridge.ts:108-113`): the subprocess cannot know the launch flag. Host ownership also gives Claude/Codex/Nestor sessions the event, which they do not have today. Call it from the session-bootstrap path, before the first `SessionStart` emission (`pi-agent.ts:6538-6549`) and NOT from inside `chatImpl` — `--init-only` never sends a prompt, so a first-turn call site cannot satisfy the doc.

blastRadius:
Crosses two wire boundaries and one persistence boundary — a risk trigger under AGENTS.md.

- Subprocess<->host wire: the Setup emission travels as `{ type: 'automation_event', event, input }` (`packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:1969`) and is dispatched at `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:2324-2344`. Removing the emission changes what crosses it, and the packaged Pi bundle is a prebuilt artifact (`apps/electron/resources/pi-agent-server/index.js`), so host and subprocess must ship from the same build.
- CLI<->server wire: the new `setupTrigger` must be added to the session-create RPC payload; keep it optional so an older CLI against a newer server, and the reverse, both still work.
- Frozen contract: `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1` (`packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:38`) is re-exported as `PI_LIFECYCLE_HOOK_CONTRACTS` (`packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.ts:24-25`) and read through `getAgentEventContractV1`; membership and version are pinned by `lifecycle-bridge.test.ts:163` and `:175`.
- Shared field: `SdkAutomationInput.trigger` (`types.ts:768`) is also PreCompact/PostCompact's matcher field, written at `lifecycle-bridge.ts:151-160` and read at `utils.ts:204-206`. Widening the union touches every reader.
- Persistence: user automations live in `automations.json` keyed by event with a matcher string per entry (parsed at `apps/electron/src/renderer/components/automations/types.ts:444-465`). No schema migration is needed, but the MEANING of already-saved records changes: a stored catch-all `Setup` automation stops running every session, and a stored `init`/`maintenance` one starts running. Same for agent-authored ones — `Setup` is in the writable list at `packages/session-tools-core/src/handlers/automation-management.ts:56`.
- Imported-plugin path: `packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters.ts:124` (Claude `Setup`), `:183` and `:200` (Codex `Setup`/`setup`), `packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:152` (handler-type restriction), `packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-runtime.ts:26` and `:157` (event inventory), `packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-automation.ts:373` (event map).
- Renderer/UI: `apps/electron/src/renderer/components/automations/types.ts:46`, `:58`, `:502` (event union, list, category) and `apps/electron/src/renderer/playground/registry/automations.tsx:119`. No per-event matcher vocabulary is hard-coded in the renderer, so no UI table needs the two new values.
- Tests to update: `packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.test.ts:46`; `packages/shared/src/automations/conditions.test.ts:661-668`; `packages/shared/src/plugins/__tests__/hooks-automation.test.ts:305-329`. Tests to re-run unchanged: `packages/shared/src/automations/hook-decision-contract.test.ts:34` and `:233`, `packages/shared/src/plugins/__tests__/format-adapters.test.ts:3594`.
userImpact:
Observable today, in three distinct ways.

1. Over-firing. Install a Claude plugin whose `hooks/hooks.json` has a `Setup` entry with no matcher, and its command runs on EVERY Pi session start — every new chat, and again on any agent dispose+recreate (the `sessionStarted` guard is a fresh closure per `createSession` call, `pi-runtime-adapter.ts:258-272`). hooks.md:1061 reserves this hook for "one-time dependency installation or scheduled cleanup that you trigger explicitly from CI or scripts", so the user pays that work — an `npm install`-class command or a cleanup script — on every chat, as startup latency and repeated disk/network activity, where Claude would have run it once from CI.
2. Silent non-firing of the correct spelling. The same plugin written the documented way, `"matcher": "init"`, never runs at all. The user does get told: the plugin's diagnostics show a warning `plugin.hooks.matcher_never_matches` — "Hook ... declares a matcher on \"Setup\", which has no matcher value in Nessy, so the hook never runs ... Remove the matcher to run on every occurrence" (`hooks-automation.ts:768-777`) — but the only remedy that advice offers is exactly case 1.
3. No maintenance path, and provider-dependent behaviour. There is no `--init-only` / `-p --init` / `-p --maintenance` launch mode anywhere in the product (`apps/cli/src/index.ts:77-140`), so a user cannot run a plugin's cleanup pass at all. And because the Pi bridge is the only emitter, a session on the Claude, Codex or Nestor Cloud backend never fires `Setup` — the same installed plugin behaves differently depending on which model card the user picked.
notes: Every file cited was read in this session. Two things rest on code reading rather than a live run, and neither changes the finding: (a) the "runs on every new chat" claim is derived from `lifecycle-bridge.ts:104-115` + `pi-agent.ts:2324-2344` + the plugin-hook registration path, not from a packaged build — AGENTS.md notes that live evidence must come from a packaged build, and none was taken; (b) I did not confirm the desktop shell's chat-to-Pi-session ratio, so "per new chat" is really "per `createSession` call". One near-miss worth recording: the cwd-change re-create path at `packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:3031` also builds a fresh lifecycle extension, but its sink is a `createPiLifecycleSinkGate` that starts CLOSED (`:2957`, default `initiallyOpen = false` at `lifecycle-bridge.ts:41`) and only opens at commit (`:3218`), so the candidate session's `session_start` Setup is dropped — a cwd change does not re-emit. Staged fallback if the launch modes are out of scope for this release: change item 5 alone (delete `lifecycle-bridge.ts:107`) removes the false firing in one line, at the cost of making `Setup` unreachable rather than wrong; do not ship that half without also removing `Setup` from the writable/importable event lists, or plugin authors get a hook that registers and never runs with no diagnostic.
